nodes.label: Vite Dev Proxy for Relay CORS Avoidance
nodes.rationale: In dev mode all /relay requests are proxied to https://mobicloud-relay-3.onrender.com to avoid CORS and browser tracking protection blocks; in prod VITE_RELAY_URL is used directly.

nodes.label: MobiCloud Relay Server (mobicloud-relay-3.onrender.com)
